sentences.text: Petitioner  Mr. P. Behera, Advocate  -versus-  State of Odisha ....

Opposite Party  Mr. A. Pradhan, ASC  CORAM: JUSTICE V. NARASINGH  ORDER 21.07.2023 Order No.
02. 1.
Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

2. The Petitioner is an accused in G.R Case No.77 of 2023 pending on the file of learned ADJ-cum-Special Court under POCSO Act, Berhampur, arising out of Badabazar P.S. Case No.158 of 2023 for commission of the offence under Sections 363/376(2)(n) IPC and Section 6 of the POCSO Act.

3. Being aggrieved by the rejection of his application for bail U/s. 439 Cr.P.C by the learned ADJ-cum-Special Court under POCSO Act, Berhampur, by order dated 24.06.2023 in the aforementioned case, the present BLAPL has been filed.
4. It is submitted by the learned counsel that the Petitioner is in custody since 18.5.2023 and as charge sheet has been filed on 11.7.2023, his further continuance in custody is not warranted.
5. Learned counsel for the State opposes the prayer for bail.
6. Perused the statement of the victim recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C, which is placed on record by the learned counsel for the Petitioner.
7. It is apt to note that in the said statement, there is no allegation of the offence under Section 376 IPC.
